limitations: Kubernetes tokens, Vault login/key/sign replies and Authority retained storage are authored boundaries. No live Kubernetes/Vault/AWS proof is claimed.

The fixture prepares and reads back its retained birth record, publishes and reads back its exact source pin before operation preparation, and calls the production retained-registry reader over the authored backend. It is not the missing host production registry adapter.

Registered controls preserve the complete original home seed and logical/native generation one. Separate packaged controls cover independent origins and native/logical divergence; these native controls do not claim rotation or independent-origin attestation.
Server authentication derives trust from the current retained pair. The caller independently checks live registry membership before capability construction and before/after each signature.
Registry loss during signing is injected after the native sign request. The signature result is suppressed before a coordinator frame is sent; the prepared record and pin remain retained.
Closed-parent reuse refuses before another Vault request. Exact manager/kernel/workspace absence does not close an unknown manager admission or retire immutable launch inputs.

Only native fixture and test sources changed. Production dispatch, causal admission closure, launch-input retirement/recovery, broader composition gates and normalized deployment qualification remain owed.
